scope: Extend the existing project motion system across all 12 interaction families and close the 15 audited gaps.

families.implementation: Existing pressable, visible press hold, focus ring and lift menu retained; shared field focus now animates its border.
CinemaSelectionGroup now carries spring velocity; existing chip, switch and slider components retained.
Existing root/subtab indicators retained; unified-library filters now use accessible animated YfChip.
Existing CinemaPosterNavigation and SharedMediaTransition round trip retained, including interrupted/predictive back handling.
Existing dialog presence retained; shared size motion respects hidden routes and calm mode; TV biography now expands through it.
Spring placement shared by lazy lists and grids; account device and personal conflict rows have stable independent motion nodes; bookmarks support undo.
Existing search/IME integration retained; focused form border and button label handoffs added; system keyboard animation remains platform-owned.
Existing skeleton/refresh/pagination retained; unified library refresh stages the previously read extent without blanking existing content.
Shared OperationFeedback uses actual operation state; ExclusiveUiOperation acquires synchronously and releases on cancellation.
Existing controls and gestures retained; subtitle download has busy state instead of a selected check; bookmark save/undo/jump feedback added.
Migration, metadata, routes, sync, authentication and scan progress/result paths integrated; existing download and handoff feedback retained.
Existing focus, parallax and single-tree window-size handoff retained; TV biography and calendar navigation extended.

auditedGaps: Migration busy guard and semantic outcomes
Bookmark save locator, delete undo and seek timestamp
Unified library refresh retention and animated filters/grid
Server routes and HTTPS probe status
Family profile selection locator and feedback
Sync operation and conflict row feedback
Phone remote direction and connection state feedback
Metadata operation-specific feedback and selection locator
File scan real progress and saved results shortcut
TV calendar direct date and unwatched navigation
preserved: Only player floating menus permit pull-down dismissal
Playback, source selection and synchronization policies
Pinned MDK component and full ARM64 delivery
validationLimit: No physical Android device is connected; instrumented tests are compiled, not executed. Device frame-time, input-latency and visual tuning remain unmeasured.
